chunks: Indeed, these hearts are containers, so the best of them is that which preserves (its contents). So, preserve what I say to you
ai.seo_question: What is the metaphor of the heart in Imam Ali's wisdom regarding knowledge?
ai.summary: This opening line of the famous 'Hadith of Kumayl' establishes the epistemological foundation of Shia spirituality, where the heart (qalb) is viewed not merely as a seat of emotion but as a vessel for divine gnosis (ma'rifah). Scholarly tradition emphasizes that the quality of this 'container' depends on its purity and readiness to receive the 'best' of knowledge, linking intellectual capacity with spiritual receptivity. This metaphor underscores the necessity of guarding sacred teachings from corruption, a theme central to the transmission of Imami wisdom.

en.sayed-ali-raza: these hearts are containers. The best of them is that which preserves (its contents). So, preserve what I say to you:
